params.message:
Drop the trial topic from the contact form, and trial_request with it

Nothing on the site linked to "Early access to a paid plan"; a visitor
reached it only by picking it from the list, and it was the one topic
that became a Clay lead. The option is gone, and so is the Clay route
it fed: the contact.received mapping, ClayLeads::REQUEST and the
backfill's replay of trial messages. Old messages keep their topic;
Clay keeps the rows it has.

Portal: Het contactformulier van gentells.com biedt "Early access to a paid plan" niet meer aan.
